user.title: Set up Duosida Local
user.description: Choose LAN discovery or enter the charger address manually.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: The integration verifies TCP connectivity and reads the charger identifier before saving.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Duosida Local
reconfigure.description: Change the network address. The charger identifier must match the existing device.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the charger.
error.invalid_response: The device replied, but its response is not a supported Duosida protocol message.
error.different_device: The new address belongs to a different charger.

abort.no_devices_found: No chargers were discovered. Try manual setup.
abort.discovery_failed: LAN discovery could not start. Check network permissions or use manual setup.

command_failed.message: The charger command failed or could not be confirmed.

whole_amps_required.message: The charger accepts whole amperes only.

connection_lost.title: Connection to the Duosida charger was lost
connection_lost.description: The integration cannot reconnect to the charger at {host}. Verify power, Wi-Fi, IP address and TCP port 9988.
